text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Something's emerging!? And from all over, so many of them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか湧いて出てきたんだけど！？
あっちこっちから、
数ばかり多いっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they’re its cronies.
But relying on numbers isn't significant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちらさんの取り巻きみたいだね。
だけど、
数に頼るってのは大したことない！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
We don't have time for small fry!
Let's scatter them and attack the main target!
text_block_list.orig_text:
雑魚に関わってる暇はないんだ！
とっとと蹴散らして
本丸を攻めるよ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we can't deal with them one by one!
Let's sweep them away together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
一体一体相手してらんないわ！
ここはまとめて
薙ぎ払うっ！
